role: Blogger, secular activist, and survivor of an attack
contribution: Asif Mohiuddin was a blogger and secular activist whose writing and public presence connected him to the Shahbag-era debate over war-crimes justice, religion, and free expression. He survived a stabbing attack in January 2013.
context: His activism unfolded amid threats against secular bloggers and the mobilization and counter-mobilization surrounding Shahbag. The attack, subsequent prosecution, and his later life abroad became part of Bangladesh's debate over protection for writers and online speech.
impact: Mohiuddin became a prominent example of the personal risks faced by secular and critical bloggers in Bangladesh. His survival also kept attention on the relationship between extremist violence, state protection, and civic freedom.
highlight: Secular blogger who survived a 2013 stabbing attack during the Shahbag-era crisis.
seoTitle: Asif Mohiuddin: Secular Blogger and Activist
seoDescription: Learn about Asif Mohiuddin, the Bangladeshi secular blogger and activist who survived an attack during the 2013 Shahbag-era political crisis.
shortAnswer: Asif Mohiuddin was a secular blogger and activist who survived a stabbing attack in January 2013.

faq.question: What happened to Asif Mohiuddin in 2013?
faq.answer: He survived a stabbing attack in January 2013 amid heightened threats against secular bloggers and activists.
